시편 118:1.content: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

시편 118:2.content: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

시편 118:3.content: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

시편 118:4.content: Let them now that fear the Lord say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

시편 118:5.content: I called upon the Lord in distress: the Lord answered me, and set me in a large place.

시편 118:6.content: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

시편 118:7.content: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

시편 118:8.content: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.

시편 118:9.content: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.

시편 118:10.content: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.

시편 118:11.content: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

시편 118:12.content: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

시편 118:13.content: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.

시편 118:14.content: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

시편 118:15.content: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

시편 118:16.content: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

시편 118:17.content: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.

시편 118:18.content: The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

시편 118:19.content: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:

시편 118:20.content: This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.

시편 118:21.content: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

시편 118:22.content: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

시편 118:23.content: This is the Lord’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

시편 118:24.content: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

시편 118:25.content: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

시편 118:26.content: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

시편 118:27.content: God is the Lord, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

시편 118:28.content: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

시편 118:29.content: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
